$comment: Consumed:  Role B (assert_state lives on the MCP server), Role D (harness parses traces).
Two schemas: (1) delegate_task input, (2) the subagent result envelope that is the
ONLY thing injected into the main context after a subagent's context is dropped.

delegate_task_input.description: Tool call the main agent makes to spawn an ephemeral, scoped subagent.

success_criteria.description: The verify contract. assert_state(query, expect) must pass for the subagent to emit status=success.

expect.description: Structured match or predicate over query output.

tools.description: Whitelist of MCP tool names the subagent may call (least privilege).

subagent_result_envelope.description: Schema-validated result the subagent emits. Its context is then DROPPED; only this object enters the main context.

summary.description: 1-3 lines. What was achieved (or why not).

evidence.description: Reference to the assert_state pass. Logged in JSONL; NOT injected into main context by default.
